name: Truthifi
description: One verified household record for your AI: accounts, activity, holdings, fees, performance, cash flow, the advisors on your accounts, financial diagnostics, and your Truthifi Score with the findings behind it. Can't move money. Authenticates via OAuth in your browser.

auth.instructions: Sign in to Truthifi in your browser (OAuth). The server supports Dynamic Client Registration, so no client ID or API key is needed. Free plan available; some tools need a paid plan.
